parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. You can obtain it from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: workitemId
parameters.description: The work item ID, which is the same as the workitemIdentifier field and serves as the UUID of the work item.
